notes: Important fix: placing an order on the web ordering portal works again (it had been refusing orders with "Invalid input"). New: card payment at checkout with Authorize.net for chosen user groups, refunds from the order page and a "Paid by card" credit on the invoice; warehouse-aware orders — stock is reserved and picked only in the order's own building, and anything short there waits in a new Transfers queue instead of shipping from the wrong place; returns can go straight back to the shelf they were picked from, and a shipment marked shipped by mistake can be undone; brands' own fonts on their storefront; and putaway rules per customer (reserved zones and locations, preferred zones).
